notes:
When a clip comes out with the wrong area at the top, you can now fix it yourself. Open the clip and press "Fix the camera": the 16:9 frame the clip was cut from opens, you drag a box over the streamer's camera, and the clip is rebuilt from the original recording — same resolution, subtitles intact, nothing re-encoded twice. You can also have Jolnova remember that area for the streamer so new clips come out right. If the recording a clip came from is already gone, the button says so instead of failing.

Clips made by earlier versions are protected too: while their recording is still on disk, Jolnova now saves the 16:9 source piece before the recording is cleaned up, so those clips stay fixable afterwards.

You now decide how every clip goes up. Pressing Publish opens an upload window first, with the title, the description and who can see it (Private / Unlisted / Public) already filled in. Change whatever you like, then upload. The Sharing page has the same description box and visibility picker, for both "Upload now" and "Schedule for later". Descriptions are measured in bytes the way YouTube measures them, so a long Turkish or German description is no longer rejected after the whole video was sent.

The Sharing calendar now shows your next upload and the month's totals under it.

YouTube channel statistics are no longer written to your disk, and the YouTube mark is shown in its official colours and size everywhere it appears.
